scripts.check:rust: cargo fmt --all --check && cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings && cargo test --workspace --locked
scripts.test:adaptive-worker: npm run build:adaptive-worker && npm run build:rust && dotnet build Flaggo.slnx -c Debug --no-restore && node examples/adaptive-worker/smoke.mjs
scripts.test:tetris-app: npm run build:tetris && npm run build:tetris-flaggo && node --test examples/tetris-integration/test/contract-deployment.test.mjs examples/tetris-integration/test/contract.test.mjs examples/tetris-integration/test/drop-interval.test.mjs examples/tetris-integration/test/experience.test.mjs examples/tetris-integration/test/game.test.mjs examples/tetris-integration/test/greedy-player.test.mjs examples/tetris-integration/test/realtime-autonomous-session.test.mjs examples/tetris-integration/test/flaggo-provider.test.mjs examples/tetris-integration/test/host-process.test.mjs examples/tetris-integration/test/session-telemetry.test.mjs examples/tetris-integration/test/session.test.mjs examples/tetris-integration/test/terminal.test.mjs
scripts.test:tetris-integration: npm run build:tetris-integration && npm run build:rust && dotnet build Flaggo.slnx -c Debug --no-restore && node examples/tetris-integration/run.mjs
scripts.tetris:flaggo: npm run build:tetris-flaggo && npm run build:rust && dotnet build Flaggo.slnx -c Debug && node examples/tetris-integration/run-flaggo.mjs
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspaces && npm run typecheck:tetris
scripts.typecheck:tetris: tsc -p examples/tetris-integration/tsconfig.standalone.json --noEmit && npm run build --workspace @flaggo/sdk && tsc -p examples/tetris-integration/tsconfig.json --noEmit
